column1: # Rules for the ZAP baseline scan in CI (the zap job in .github/workflows/ci.yml).
# Each line: rule id (or * for all), TAB, IGNORE | WARN | FAIL | OUTOFSCOPE, TAB, a note or, for OUTOFSCOPE, a URL regex.
# The job fails on any alert, so every IGNORE needs a reason.
# Swagger UI and the OpenAPI document are developer documentation, off in production (SWAGGER_ENABLED=false).
# Informational: responses that may not be cached. Intended for an API whose responses carry credentials or
# personal data; token responses also send Cache-Control: no-store.
